The [research](research.qmd) posts on this site try to stay readable without
a biology degree, but some background comes up again and again: what makes a
frog a frog and not a toad, what "relaxed selection" actually means, why
biologists keep saying *Dollo's law*. Rather than re-explain it every time,
short posts here will do it once, and the research posts will link back to
them.
